grbio.2026.1.4.source_format: Official Panhellenic examination paper (Greek), published by the Hellenic Ministry of Education, with an English translation
grbio.2026.1.4.source_variant_note: Figure 2 (the DNA segment) and Figure 3 (the plasmid) are cropped from the paper; the two strands of Figure 2 are also retyped as text lines below the figure, with the dashed lines at points K and Λ shown as (K) and (Λ). The three recognition sequences of the restriction endonucleases are printed as a diagram with arrows; they are retyped as text, with ↓ and ↑ at the cutting positions shown by the arrows. The Roman numerals of ΠΕΙ, ΠΕΙΙ, ΠΕΙΙΙ (restriction endonucleases I–III) are given as RE I, RE II, RE III in the English text.
